beforeDecision.rationale: BY Ph10 profile NTG 5.1: own experimental diode investigation and recorded characteristic. Other semiconductor application/build components remain on their existing targets. NTG is a source annotation, not a new runtime selector.

afterDecision.rationale: K1 global-result repair 2026-11-15: BY Ph10.5.1 (official NTG profile) explicitly requires personal semiconductor-circuit construction and investigation. The transistor own-experiment component maps to the distinct experimental identity77ab; interpretation7d remains separately supported by the Ph10.5.2 model clause. Other diode/application components retain their existing partial targets. This does not claim every Bavarian Gymnasium profile mandates the NTG component and introduces no new track selector. Explicit remaining component: the official NTG content also includes personally investigating a transistor amplifier. That own amplifier experiment is not covered by switching-only77ab, interpretation7d/88, or supplied-material amplifieraf/144. This mapping remains partial; whole Ph10.5.1/NTG completion is not claimed. The own-amplifier component requires a subsequent coherent practical delivery.

officialScope: BY Ph10.5.1, NTG profile. Explicit selected technical BY GK/LK and national union projections; no assertion about all Bavarian Gymnasium profiles.
rootParentRationale: A separate actual-experiment competence belongs directly to the Physics root; inserting it into the broadly reused theoretical transistor subtree would incorrectly expose unneeded personal experiments in advanced prerequisite-only scopes. The existing projection layer supplies the bounded topical lower learner placement.
requiresRationale: Complete operational plan, pins, common return, safe module limits and control conventions are supplied. Existing69f secures circuit/diagram translation and its basic circuit foundation; microscopic7d/pn/carrier theory and quantitative meter skills are not necessary preparation.
